title: campanula cervicaria var. longifolia
intro: Campanula cervicaria var. longifolia, commonly known as bellflower, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Campanula cervicaria var. longifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
